WRITTEN RESOLUTIONS PASSED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF DAFTARKHWAN (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) ON THIS _____________________________ 
 
 Agenda 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to avail a loan in the principal amount of USD 1,00 0,000 (United States Dollar one million ) for working capital purposes from Daftarkhwan Holdings Limited (“ Lender ”). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Ahmad Habib, Director of the Company, to discuss, negotiate and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved that , the Company may avail a loan in the principal amount of USD 1,00 0,000 (United States Dollar one million ) for working capital purposes from the Lender. 
 
 Resolved further that , Ahmad Habib be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute on behalf of the Company all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction. 
 
 
 
 
 
 ___________________________ _____________________________ 
 Saad Idrees Ahmad Habib 
 Director Director
